svg.title: Diagnosing a slow Spark job: plan, then metrics, then layout, then settings
svg.desc: Spark performance diagnosis framework: 4-step diagnostic order (Physical plan, Stage metrics, Code/Table layout fixes, Settings last) and 4 key plan anti-pattern fingerprints (PushedFilters empty, BatchEvalPython UDF fallback, Unnecessary SortMergeJoin, Missing AdaptiveSparkPlan wrapper).
svg.text: Diagnosing a Slow Spark Job — The Ordered Diagnostic Path
Read physical plan ➔ Check stage metrics (spill & skew) ➔ Fix code or table layout ➔ Change settings last

g.title: 1. Read the physical plan — The physical plan is the first place to look, and EXPLAIN never executes the query.
g.text: • Check final adaptive plan in Spark UI

g.title: 2. Check stage metrics — Stage metrics reveal spill, skew and task-count problems directly.
g.text: • Data Skew: Max task duration far

g.aria-label: 3. Fix the code or the layout
g.title: 3. Fix the code or the layout — Most real wins come from fixing code or table layout, not configuration.
g.text: Fix cast on join key ➔ pushdown
• Replace Python UDF with native SQL
• Resolve join skew via key salting
Never mask bad query code or bad
Delta table layout with cluster scaling.

g.title: 4. Change settings last — Fabric's defaults are good, and pasted settings often defeat adaptive execution.

svg.text: LANE 2: THE FOUR PLAN FINGERPRINTS & DIRECT REMEDIATIONS

g.title: PushedFilters is empty — An empty PushedFilters list means the scan is reading everything.
BatchEvalPython appears — A row-at-a-time Python UDF breaks fusion, serializes rows and forces native fallback.
g.text: • Drops Native Velox engine to JVM

g.title: SortMergeJoin on a small side — A sort-merge join on a small side pays two sorts and two shuffles unnecessarily.
g.text: • Stale table statistics or AQE missed

g.title: No AdaptiveSparkPlan wrapper — A missing adaptive plan wrapper means no runtime re-optimization happened.
g.text: • Root Cause: Query plan is frozen

svg.text: Fabric Codex — Original Diagram, August 2026. Sourced from Apache Spark EXPLAIN Plans, Performance Tuning & Fabric Spark Toolkit.
